description: Return the public half of one of this server's keys (ES256, 64 bytes x‖y, as hex, base64 and an SPKI PEM) and where it lives, creating it on first use. which: "log" (the default) is the key that owns your data log: a grant issuer names it in the grant's grantData, and a grant naming any other key cannot carry statements this server signs. which: "authority" is the requester's key that owns your authority log and signs the grants issue_grant makes. Never returns private key material.

which.description: which key: "log" (default), the key that owns your data log and signs statements; or "authority", the requester's key that owns an authority log and signs the child grants issue_grant makes

name: get_log_key
title: Get the log key
